product_one_liner.value: Talowiz provides talent-acquisition teams with AI agents that autonomously source, evaluate, interview, and select candidates, automating recruitment workflows.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page describes its credit-based, pay-as-you-go pricing.

named_customers.notes: Both names appear in client testimonials on Talowiz’s homepage.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 15 employees, which falls in the 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: Tracxn identifies San Jose as headquarters, matching the San Jose address in Talowiz’s privacy policy; some third-party profiles list Ashburn.

founded_year.notes: Talowiz’s LinkedIn company profile gives 2022 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows recruitment/product guidance and feature-explainer posts, not at least two technical posts about how the product is built by engineers.

public_docs.notes: The visible site navigation/footer links include pricing, blog, terms, and privacy, but no public product documentation or help center.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers listing says there are no open positions as of November 9, 2026.

model_provider.value: Talowiz says it developed a custom AI model for personalization; it does not name an external model provider.
model_provider.notes: This is the model disclosure found in the privacy policy; it describes personalization and does not identify an outside LLM vendor.

compliance_certs.notes: Talowiz publicly names SOC 2 and GDPR-related features; the cited wording says only “ISO,” so it does not establish ISO 27001 specifically or independently verify certification.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook labels the latest deal Early Stage VC but the displayed funding table does not provide a date or amount; Dealroom says no known external funding. The records conflict, so a complete round cannot be established. Zero and the empty date are neutral placeholders, not claims about the actual amount or date.

raised_18mo.notes: No source supplies a date for PitchBook’s Early Stage VC deal, while Dealroom reports no known external funding; the available evidence cannot establish whether a round occurred from May 9, 2025 through November 9, 2026. False is the schema-required neutral boolean alongside unknown status.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers listing reports no open positions as of November 9, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable blog and company-post history shows its newest dated posts before May 9, 2026, and no dated launch announcement in the six-month window; the newer product pages are not launch announcements.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current org-chart listing shows the founder/CEO, and the small team listing identifies the cofounder as having been there about five years; these sources do not show a C-level/VP start within the window or a departure announcement.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable integrations discussion names Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, and Darwinbox for hiring workflows, but no CRM or sales/marketing system.
